name: generate_todo_dataset
title: GenerateTodoDatasetTool
description: JSON-RPC Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool schema for generating synthetic TodoMVC datasets supporting parameterized and data-driven testing with strict typing.

includeSpecialChars.description: Flag indicating whether items should include Unicode, emojis, accents, and extreme length boundary strings

state.description: Initial target completion state distribution of generated todo items ('active', 'completed', or 'mixed')
